FIFA President Infantino Survives Leadership Challenge After Botched Plan

FIFA President Gianni Infantino has apologized for "mistakes made" regarding a controversial plan to sell stakes in the World Cup. Despite the retraction of the plan, senior FIFA officials have reaffirmed their "full support" for Infantino, allowing him to remain president. The crisis meeting was held in Rabat, Morocco, where a truce was reportedly reached. However, debates surrounding FIFA's governance are expected to continue.
